function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve possible modes of transportation between two cities based on their geographical coordinates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL of the API endpoint for retrieving data.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept-Encoding.description: The encoding in which to receive the response.

headers.description: Dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float. If a tuple is provided, it specifies a connect timeout and a read timeout respectively. This is a float type value.

origin_lat.description: Latitude of the origin location in decimal degrees. This is a float type value.

origin_lng.description: Longitude of the origin location in decimal degrees. This is a float type value.

destination_lat.description: Latitude of the destination location in decimal degrees. This is a float type value.

destination_lng.description: Longitude of the destination location in decimal degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

auth.description: HTTP authentication provided as a tuple of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to SSL client cert file (.pem) or a tuple of ('cert', 'key') pair.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: Whether to immediately download the response content or stream it.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not.
